note: Hyde County (NC) has no county-wide zoning. Its only zoning-type district map is the Ocracoke Development Ordinance Map, linked from the county ordinances page but published as a document, not a queryable service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online found no Hyde zoning district layer; the county parcel viewer (Hyde_AGOL, services3.arcgis.com/nJbIFHiSnaX0z0hS) has parcels, flood zones, fire districts but no zoning. The county GIS viewer (hydecountygis.com, Experience app) does not expose a zoning service I could inspect. Swan Quarter and Engelhard are unincorporated, so no municipal zoning layer was found.
